name: Taste Skill
summary: Open-source SKILL.md files that give AI coding agents design rules for typography, spacing, color, layout and motion.
description: Taste Skill installs into a project as SKILL.md files so AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, v0 and more) produce design-directed frontends instead of generic AI layouts. Thirteen skills cover the core design skill, redesign audits, style variants (soft, minimalist, brutalist), image generation and output enforcement; the core skill exposes DESIGNVARIANCE, MOTIONINTENSITY and VISUALDENSITY dials on a 1-10 scale. Install with npx skills add; MIT licensed.
contains: 13 skills, one install: core, redesign, output and style variants
3-dial system: design variance, motion intensity, visual density (1-10)
works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, v0 and other SKILL.md agents
v2 core skill adds brief inference, design system map and dark mode protocol
